title: LA Colossal – Black Najeon 04 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Korean woman in her early 30s, high ponytail with a pearl band, natural face with a quiet smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the ledge, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with iridescent mother-of-pearl lotus flowers, mandarin ducks, and Korean ripple patterns. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated upright on a wooden pavilion ledge, torso facing the camera, legs crossed at the knee, both hands resting lightly on her upper knee with elbows relaxed out. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch black lacquer peep-toe platform stilettos with a single pearl ankle strap.
Nails: Extra long oval nails, black with pearl tips.

Background & Lighting: Korean lotus pond pavilion at dusk, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm lantern key with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
